summary: Reproduced the source-side len(None) failure in the current attn_cp_tp_broadcast_pyobj implementation for the reported 2x2 attention TP/CP topology. Changed the two-stage broadcast to propagate from the combined leader across attention CP before using each CP rank's attention-TP source, and added regression plus one-dimensional boundary coverage.

tests.what_was_measured: The reported attn_tp_rank=0, attn_cp_rank=1 source path raised TypeError from len(None); the independent TP-only and CP-only boundaries passed. Raw output: reports/j-c9ff5b2d7dff/failing-before.log
All four broadcast topology cases and four existing PP/CP scheduler cases passed (8 passed). Raw output: reports/j-c9ff5b2d7dff/focused-tests.log
All applicable repository formatting, lint, spelling, and registered-test checks passed. Raw output: reports/j-c9ff5b2d7dff/pre-commit.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect is in Python object-broadcast ordering. The assigned single GPU cannot instantiate the reported topology, which requires at least attn_tp_size=2 and attn_cp_size=2 (four participating ranks).

remaining_limitations: The original 8-GPU DeepSeek-V4 serving command was not run because only one gfx950 GPU was assigned and the model weights were not available.

Validation deterministically exercises the actual checked-out broadcast helper with mocked group topology and the real source-side len(data) precondition; it is not a multi-process or full-model reproduction.
